---
title: "Neuropsych PDF Table Extractor"
subtitle: "Template for extracting score tables from neuropsychological test PDFs"
format: 
  html:
    toc: true
    theme: cosmo
server: shiny
params:
  # Customize these for your specific test
  test_code: "wrat5"
  test_name: "WRAT-5"
  default_page: 2
  score_type: "standard_score"  # standard_score, scaled_score, t_score
  test_type: "npsych_test"
  domain: "Academic Skills"
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(tabulapdf)
library(DT)

neuro2_available <- requireNamespace("neuro2", quietly = TRUE)
if (neuro2_available) library(neuro2)

options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 50 * 1024^2)

# Test configurations - add your tests here
test_configs <- list(
  wrat5 = list(
    name = "WRAT-5",
    domain = "Academic Skills",
    score_type = "standard_score",
    scales = c("Math Computation", "Spelling", "Word Reading", 
               "Sentence Comprehension", "Reading Composite")
  ),
  wrat4 = list(
    name = "WRAT-4", 
    domain = "Academic Skills",
    score_type = "standard_score",
    scales = c("Word Reading", "Spelling", "Math Computation", 
               "Sentence Comprehension", "Reading Composite")
  ),
  wiat4 = list(
    name = "WIAT-4",
    domain = "Academic Skills", 
    score_type = "standard_score",
    scales = c("Word Reading", "Pseudoword Decoding", "Reading Comprehension",
               "Spelling", "Sentence Composition", "Math Problem Solving",
               "Numerical Operations", "Oral Reading Fluency")
  ),
  cvlt3 = list(
    name = "CVLT-3",
    domain = "Memory",
    score_type = "standard_score",
    scales = c("Trial 1", "Trial 5", "Trials 1-5 Total", "Short Delay Free",
               "Long Delay Free", "Recognition Hits", "False Positives")
  ),
  dkefs = list(
    name = "D-KEFS",
    domain = "Attention/Executive",
    score_type = "scaled_score",
    scales = c("Trail Making Test", "Verbal Fluency", "Design Fluency",
               "Color-Word Interference", "Tower", "Sorting")
  ),
  wais5 = list(
    name = "WAIS-5",
    domain = "General Cognitive Ability",
    score_type = "scaled_score",
    scales = c("Vocabulary", "Similarities", "Block Design", "Matrix Reasoning",
               "Digit Span", "Arithmetic", "Symbol Search", "Coding")
  ),

    name = "WISC-V",

    name = "Conners-4",

    score_type = "t_score",

               "Impulsivity", "Emotional Dysregulation", "ADHD Index")
  ),
  basc3 = list(
    name = "BASC-3",
    domain = "Emotional/Behavioral/Social",
    score_type = "t_score",
    scales = c("Externalizing", "Internalizing", "Behavioral Symptoms Index",
               "Adaptive Skills", "Attention Problems", "Hyperactivity")
  ),
  pai = list(
    name = "PAI",
    domain = "Emotional/Behavioral/Personality",
    score_type = "t_score",
    scales = c("Somatic Complaints", "Anxiety", "Anxiety-Related Disorders",
               "Depression", "Mania", "Paranoia", "Schizophrenia",
               "Borderline Features", "Antisocial Features")
  )
)

# Load lookup table if available
lookup_path <- "~/Dropbox/neuropsych_lookup_table.csv"
if (file.exists(lookup_path)) {
  lookup_table <- read.csv(lookup_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else {
  lookup_table <- data.frame(
    test = character(), scale = character(), 
    domain = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Instructions

1. **Select Test** - Choose your neuropsychological test from the dropdown
2. **Upload PDF** - Upload the test report PDF
3. **Configure Extraction** - Select page and map columns
4. **Download** - Export cleaned CSV for your workflow

---

```{r}
#| panel: sidebar

# Test Selection
selectInput(
  "test_code",
  "Select Test Battery",
  choices = names(test_configs),
  selected = params$test_code
)

hr()

# File Upload
fileInput("file", "Upload PDF Report", accept = c(".pdf"))

# Extraction Settings
numericInput("pages", "Page(s) to Scan", value = params$default_page, min = 1, max = 50)

selectInput(
  "extraction_method",
  "Extraction Method",
  choices = c("stream" = "stream", "lattice" = "lattice"),
  selected = "stream"
)

hr()

# Table Selection
uiOutput("table_selector_ui")

hr()

# Actions
actionButton("extract_btn", "Extract Tables", class = "btn-success")
downloadButton("download_csv", "Download CSV", class = "btn-primary")
```

```{r}
#| panel: fill

# Dynamic test info
uiOutput("test_info_ui")

hr()

# Status
verbatimTextOutput("status")

hr()

# Column Mapping
uiOutput("column_mapping_ui")

hr()

# Results
h4("Processed Data")
DTOutput("results_table")

hr()

# Raw preview (collapsible)
details(
  summary = "Show Raw Extraction (Debug)",
  DTOutput("raw_table")
)
```

```{r}
#| context: server

# --- HELPERS ---
safe_numeric <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", as.character(x))))
}

# Get current test config
current_config <- reactive({
  test_configs[[input$test_code]]
})

# --- UI: Test Info ---
output$test_info_ui <- renderUI({
  cfg <- current_config()
  wellPanel(
    h5(cfg$name),
    tags$small(
      paste("Domain:", cfg$domain, "| Score Type:", cfg$score_type)
    )
  )
})

# --- REACTIVE: Extract Tables ---
raw_tables <- eventReactive(input$extract_btn, {
  req(input$file)
  
  withProgress(message = "Extracting tables...", {
    tryCatch({
      tabulapdf::extract_tables(
        file = input$file$datapath,
        pages = input$pages,
        method = input$extraction_method,
        output = "matrix"
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      showNotification(paste("Error:", e$message), type = "error")
      NULL
    })
  })
})

# --- UI: Table Selector ---
output$table_selector_ui <- renderUI({
  req(raw_tables())
  n <- length(raw_tables())
  if (n > 1) {
    selectInput("table_idx", paste("Table (", n, "found)"),
                choices = seq_len(n), selected = 1)
  }
})

selected_idx <- reactive({
  if (!is.null(input$table_idx)) as.integer(input$table_idx) else 1
})

# --- REACTIVE: Candidate Table ---
candidate_df <- reactive({
  req(raw_tables())
  df <- as.data.frame(raw_tables()[[selected_idx()]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df[] <- lapply(df, trimws)
  colnames(df) <- paste0("V", seq_len(ncol(df)))
  df
})

# --- UI: Column Mapping ---
output$column_mapping_ui <- renderUI({
  req(candidate_df())
  df <- candidate_df()
  cols <- colnames(df)
  
  # Preview helper
  make_choices <- function(cols, df) {
    setNames(cols, sapply(cols, function(c) {
      preview <- paste(head(na.omit(df[[c]]), 2), collapse = ", ")
      paste0(c, " (", substr(preview, 1, 30), "...)")
    }))
  }
  
  choices <- make_choices(cols, df)
  none <- c("None" = "None")
  
  cfg <- current_config()
  
  # Different layouts based on score type
  if (cfg$score_type == "t_score") {
    # T-score layout (rating scales)
    wellPanel(
      h5("Column Mapping"),
      fluidRow(
        column(4, selectInput("col_scale", "Scale:", choices = choices, selected = cols[1])),
        column(4, selectInput("col_raw", "Raw Score:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = cols[2])),
        column(4, selectInput("col_score", "T-Score:", choices = choices, selected = cols[3]))
      ),
      fluidRow(
        column(4, selectInput("col_percentile", "Percentile:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
        column(4, selectInput("col_ci", "CI:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
        column(4, selectInput("col_range", "Range/Category:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None"))
      )
    )
  } else if (cfg$score_type == "scaled_score") {
    # Scaled score layout (subtests)
    wellPanel(
      h5("Column Mapping"),
      fluidRow(
        column(4, selectInput("col_scale", "Scale:", choices = choices, selected = cols[1])),
        column(4, selectInput("col_raw", "Raw Score:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = cols[2])),
        column(4, selectInput("col_score", "Scaled Score:", choices = choices, selected = cols[3]))
      ),
      fluidRow(
        column(4, selectInput("col_percentile", "Percentile:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
        column(4, selectInput("col_age_equiv", "Age Equiv:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
        column(4, selectInput("col_range", "Range:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None"))
      )
    )
  } else {
    # Standard score layout (academic, cognitive)
    wellPanel(
      h5("Column Mapping"),
      fluidRow(
        column(4, selectInput("col_scale", "Scale:", choices = choices, selected = cols[1])),
        column(4, selectInput("col_raw", "Raw Score:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = cols[2])),
        column(4, selectInput("col_score", "Standard Score:", choices = choices, selected = cols[3]))
      ),
      fluidRow(
        column(4, selectInput("col_ci", "95% CI:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
        column(4, selectInput("col_percentile", "Percentile:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
        column(4, selectInput("col_range", "Category:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None"))
      ),
      fluidRow(
        column(4, selectInput("col_grade", "Grade Equiv:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
        column(4, selectInput("col_gsv", "GSV:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
        column(4) # spacer
      )
    )
  }
})

# --- REACTIVE: Process Data ---
processed_data <- reactive({
  req(candidate_df(), input$col_scale, input$col_score)
  
  df <- candidate_df()
  cfg <- current_config()
  
  # Build base dataframe
  result <- data.frame(
    scale = trimws(df[[input$col_scale]]),
    score = safe_numeric(df[[input$col_score]]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Add optional columns
  add_col <- function(input_name, col_name, parser = identity) {
    if (!is.null(input[[input_name]]) && input[[input_name]] != "None") {
      result[[col_name]] <<- parser(df[[input[[input_name]]]])
    }
  }
  
  add_col("col_raw", "raw_score", safe_numeric)
  add_col("col_ci", "ci_95", function(x) gsub("–|—", "-", trimws(x)))
  add_col("col_percentile", "percentile", safe_numeric)
  add_col("col_range", "range", trimws)
  add_col("col_grade", "grade_equiv", trimws)
  add_col("col_gsv", "gsv", safe_numeric)
  add_col("col_age_equiv", "age_equiv", trimws)
  
  # Filter valid rows
  result <- result |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(scale), scale != "", !is.na(score))
  
  # Add metadata
  result <- result |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      test = input$test_code,
      test_name = cfg$name,
      domain = cfg$domain,
      test_type = "npsych_test",
      score_type = cfg$score_type
    )
  
  # Join with lookup if available
  if (nrow(lookup_table) > 0 && input$test_code %in% lookup_table$test) {
    lookup_cols <- lookup_table |>
      dplyr::filter(test == input$test_code) |>
      dplyr::select(-any_of(names(result)[names(result) != "scale"]))
    
    if (nrow(lookup_cols) > 0) {
      result <- result |>
        dplyr::left_join(lookup_cols, by = "scale")
    }
  }
  
  # Apply neuro2 ranges if available
  if (neuro2_available) {
    result <- result |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        absort = NA_character_,
        description = NA_character_,
        result = NA_character_
      )
    
    if (exists("gpluck_make_score_ranges", where = asNamespace("neuro2"))) {
      result <- neuro2::gpluck_make_score_ranges(result, test_type = "npsych_test")
    }
  }
  
  result
})

# --- OUTPUTS ---
output$status <- renderText({
  if (is.null(raw_tables())) return("Click 'Extract Tables' after uploading PDF")
  paste0("✓ ", length(raw_tables()), " table(s) | ",
         nrow(processed_data()), " records processed")
})

output$raw_table <- renderDT({
  req(candidate_df())
  datatable(candidate_df(), options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 5))
})

output$results_table <- renderDT({
  req(processed_data())
  datatable(processed_data(), 
            options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 10),
            extensions = 'Buttons',
            options = list(dom = 'Bfrtip', buttons = c('copy', 'csv')))
})

output$download_csv <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() paste0(input$test_code, "_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
  content = function(file) write.csv(processed_data(), file, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
)
```
